attribution.note: Zitron directly asserts feed dominance in his own commentary.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves the Facebook observation. Zuckerberg's plans are separable background.

contract.note: Prevailing exposure across ordinary feeds is a fair plain reading of dominance. The reporting window and measurement requirements operationalize language that supplied no numerical threshold.

evidence.note: The study predates the target period and samples selected AI-posting pages. Exposure totals lack the feed-impression denominator needed to establish December dominance.
The retrospective report covers part of the target period and was available before cutoff. Four artificial accounts and selected images cannot establish representative feed shares.

reviews.rationale: The packet documents substantial circulation and examples of AI imagery, but neither representative dominance nor a small share of December 2024 feed exposure. Missing measurements do not establish that the observation was false.

attribution.note: Zitron states and endorses the assertion and its explanation.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the claimed causal link between unreliable provenance and unavoidability, including the human-scrutiny exception.

contract.note: Pervasiveness in ordinary activity and provenance assessment of arbitrary encountered content are fair contextual readings. Allowing careful source investigation preserves the breadth of the human exception.

evidence.note: Contemporaneous developer research reports automated identification of watermarked text. Its bounded coverage does not establish general provenance or avoidance; peer review does not make it independent validation.
The contemporaneous review documents detector limitations and variable human accuracy. It does not evaluate comprehensive human investigation or establish unavoidable exposure.
The prepublication benchmark shows processing-sensitive detection and relative human performance on selected images. It does not establish general provenance reliability or practical avoidance.

reviews.rationale: Bounded automated successes challenge an absolute human-only reading, while inconsistent human detection challenges the exception. Neither settles the contract's broader scrutiny standard. The packet also lacks evidence establishing unavoidable exposure or its claimed cause, leaving the assertion unresolved.
